programs.title: LumoTV: Fingerspellers
programs.desc: Comedy about a family of deaf gangsters who use signing to protect their interests. When the Opera family threaten their dominance, a fingerspelling war ensues.

programs.title: Anastasia
programs.desc: Historical drama. The Oscar-winning Ingrid Bergman stars as an amnesiac refugee who Yul Brynner tries to pass off as the daughter of the murdered Tsar of Russia, Nicholas II.

programs.title: Canyon Passage
programs.desc: Frontier western starring Dana Andrews. An ambitious businessman journeys to rural Oregon where a complex web of life and love waits to ensnare him. Directed by Jacques Tourneur.

programs.title: The Comancheros
programs.desc: Western starring John Wayne and Stuart Whitman. A Texas Ranger is forced to team up with his prisoner while he's on a covert mission to take on a band of thieves and gunrunners.

programs.title: Destroyer
programs.desc: Second World War drama about a warship assigned to mail runs but that ends up engaged in battle anyway, starring Edward G Robinson, Glenn Ford and Marguerite Chapman.
